La Viola in Mittenwald

** Discover the cozy charm of **La Viola** in the heart of **Mittenwald**, nestled in the stunning **Tirol** Alps. This intimate restaurant invites you to savor authentic Italian cuisine with a touch of Alpine warmth. Indulge in freshly prepared pasta, wood-fired pizzas, and hearty risottos—all crafted with the finest local ingredients. Don’t miss their signature **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy, caramelized delight best enjoyed with a cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** or a glass of fine Italian wine. The rustic yet elegant ambiance, paired with panoramic views of the surrounding mountains, makes **La Viola** the perfect retreat after a day of hiking or skiing in **Mittenwald**. Whether you're craving a romantic dinner or a casual meal with friends, this gem promises an unforgettable dining experience in the heart of the Alps.
